answer: Plume-stamped vertex burn: each identity claims one vertex in a public graph, paying 45 and locking a 60-credit bond; its plume-marked vertex and thread are public. Auditors replay the graph; a copied vertex sends a ripple through it, flagging both and burning the bond. The k-th vertex costs 45+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 in fees and lock 60,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent claims once, pays 45, reclaims its bond.
